description: Bootstrap-page-only capabilities. No remote.urls: after window.location.replace() navigates to http://127.0.0.1:8642/, that page is the real CI-Server web app and gets only what capabilities/oidc-remote-deep-link.json grants it. `allow-bootstrap-commands` is load-bearing rather than tidy-up: once any src-tauri/permissions/*.toml exists, tauri-build sets has_app_manifest and the webview ACL gate starts applying to the LOCAL origin too, so the splash's own invokes must be granted explicitly or the stack never starts.
